name: Exterior Masonry Wall Surface Preparation
intent: Masonry-specific prep: cure verify, moisture test, efflorescence treatment, power wash, form-release removal (concrete), caulk masonry-to-trim, surface repair.
doctrine: Masonry prep. MC < 12% hard stop. Power wash IS allowed on masonry (1500-2500 PSI). No acid on limestone. Form-release on concrete only. Surface repair at QT3+ only. Substrate type modifier applies. Polyurethane caulk (Class 25/50) at masonry-to-trim joints.
